justification: Apply the rich-explanation standard across the brief's empty states: describeUnavailable now weaves in WHAT each layer assesses (from the section labels) so a 'no' explains itself — 'Checked for bushfire attack level, vegetation category — none recorded; for a constrained site that's good news', 'We couldn't complete the slope/aspect/drainage analysis…', 'This council's DCP provisions aren't in our dataset yet…'. Overlays empty message names the overlays checked. 'DAs' acronym fixed.

pre_impl.existing_data: SECTION_LABELS already holds a one-line description of what each section assesses; describeUnavailable already receives the section id. No new data.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Empty states were generic ('Checked — nothing recorded', 'The data source did not respond') and dropped the value of saying what was checked.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new function. describeUnavailable reads SECTION_LABELS[section].description and weaves it into the not-assessed / none-here / couldn't-complete / unavailable branches; OverlayList empty text enriched; KEY_WORDS gains das->DAs.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Pure display. When a section has no description the messages fall back to the prior generic wording.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: 'None here — Checked, nothing recorded at this property.' After: 'Checked for bushfire attack level, vegetation category — none recorded at this property. For a constrained site that's good news.'

functions.name: describeUnavailable
functions.input: the reason string, the section id, and whether satellite ran
functions.output: an empty-state label/detail/tone whose detail names what the layer assesses, drawn from SECTION_LABELS
functions.if_none: sections without a description fall back to the prior generic detail strings

values: N/A - no regulatory values; display copy drawn from existing section descriptions.
queries: N/A - no database or API query.

break_it.scenario: A section id has no entry in SECTION_LABELS
break_it.what_happens: the woven phrase could be empty/awkward
break_it.repro: what is '' when no description; each branch guards with a conditional so it falls back to the plain wording
break_it.how: the ternary on 'what' omits the phrase cleanly when absent

break_it.scenario: The 'good news' framing on a None-here is wrong for a non-constraint layer
break_it.repro: the None-here branch fires only on overlay/constraint layers (reason starts with 'no'/'none')
break_it.how: scoped to the absence-of-a-constraint case where 'nothing here' is genuinely favourable

break_it.scenario: das->DAs over-applies to a word containing 'das'
break_it.repro: formatKey splits on underscores and matches whole lowercased tokens against KEY_WORDS, so only a standalone 'das' token maps
break_it.how: KEY_WORDS matches exact tokens, not substrings

post_merge.manual_verify: Run a brief: empty cards now name what was checked (e.g. environmental overlays list the overlays; a not-run satellite layer names the analysis); 'Nearby DAs' reads correctly.
